propositions: A failed identity write (add_label or set_entity_property) after issue creation calls delete_issue and destroys the successfully-created Jira issue, inverting cost recovery
The write-ahead record_pending_key succeeds before identity writes, but rollback delete never unbinds the keyed-pending entry, leaving it pointing at a deleted key and permanently stranded
recover_pending's KEYED branch exists to retro-attach the rebar-id label deterministically without search, making the rollback delete redundant with rebar's own recovery machinery

The Jira error 'Field cannot be set' occurs in three distinct situations: field not on Create/Edit screen, jira.permission.createclone.denied workflow property set, or malformed field value — the message is misleading in roughly half the cases

The proposal is to stop deleting on identity write failure, retain the keyed-pending binding for retro-attach recovery, and declare labels as a required field on the project's Create and Edit screens in documentation
